info.title: The panel vocabulary: families, widgets, display kinds, display sources and placements of a panel

PANEL_FAMILIES.description: The panel families of a plugin (omx-panel docs/panel-layout.md): the kind of processor its panel is laid out for. The words and their order are the contract; omx-panel's tools/panel-description.mjs FAMILIES and the skin package schema read them, and keep their code.
PANEL_FAMILIES.x-why: Panel families and widgets are declarations, so they live here (vocabulary-owner rule, FreeMixer/omx-contract#157).

oneOf.description: a plugin with no family: its panel is laid out from its groups and roles
oneOf.x-text: A plugin with no family: its panel is laid out from its groups and its roles.

PANEL_STANDARD_WIDGETS.description: The standard widgets a panel picks from a descriptor and a representation (a skin) draws, in the order omx-panel's tools/panel-description.mjs STANDARD_WIDGETS lists them.

oneOf.title: switch

PANEL_WIDGETS.description: The widgets a declared panel may name for a control, and the extension serves (org.openmixer.panel-description/1): auto leaves the choice to the panel layout. The four others are the shared widgets of omx-panel's schema/panel.schema.json.

oneOf.title: auto
oneOf.description: left out of a panel declaration: the layout picks the widget from the control
oneOf.x-text: Left out of a panel declaration: the layout picks the widget from the control.

oneOf.x-text: A linear control.

oneOf.description: a two-state control

oneOf.title: selector
oneOf.description: a control that picks one of a few values
oneOf.x-text: A control that picks one of a few values.

PANEL_DISPLAY_KINDS.description: The displays a declared panel may carry, and the extension serves (org.openmixer.panel-description/1), in the order of their codes: a panel description names a display by its place here. omx-panel's tools/panel-description.mjs and omx-clap-core's panel tables read them, and keep their code.
PANEL_DISPLAY_KINDS.x-why: omx-clap-core restated these words by hand beside the families and widgets; a display kind is a declaration, so it lives here (vocabulary-owner rule).

oneOf.title: gainReductionBar
oneOf.description: a bar of the gain a dynamics processor takes off
oneOf.x-text: A bar showing the gain reduction.

oneOf.title: transferCurve
oneOf.description: a dynamics processor's output level against its input level
oneOf.x-text: The dynamics transfer curve: output level against input level.

oneOf.title: eqResponse
oneOf.description: an equaliser's frequency response
oneOf.x-text: The equaliser's frequency response.

oneOf.title: meter
oneOf.description: a level meter

oneOf.title: timeResponse
oneOf.description: a response over time: a delay's train of taps or a reverb's decay envelope
oneOf.x-text: The response over time: a delay's taps or a reverb's decay.

PANEL_DISPLAY_SOURCES.description: Where a panel description's display takes its data from, in the order of their codes (org.openmixer.panel-description/1). omx-panel's tools/panel-description.mjs and omx-clap-core's panel tables read them, and keep their code.
PANEL_DISPLAY_SOURCES.x-why: omx-clap-core and omx-plugins restated these words by hand beside the families, widgets and display kinds; a display source is a declaration, so it lives here (vocabulary-owner rule).

PANEL_STORE_CODES.description: The refusals of the descriptions store's reader and writer (omx-panel docs/descriptions-store.md, section 5): each is the qualification store's code of the same name, with panel-store. for its prefix. The loader's own codes are passed through, not repeated here.

oneOf.title: absent
oneOf.description: the base file does not exist
oneOf.x-text: The base store file does not exist.

oneOf.title: unreadable
oneOf.description: a layer exists and SQLite cannot open or read it
oneOf.x-text: A store file exists and cannot be read.

oneOf.title: notAStore
oneOf.description: a file at version 0, with no store_info row, or of another layer than the place it was opened as
oneOf.x-text: The file is not a store of the layer it was opened as.

oneOf.title: schemaMismatch
oneOf.description: the opened files are at different schema versions
oneOf.x-text: The store files are at different schema versions.

oneOf.title: schemaOther
oneOf.description: a file is at a schema version other than the reader's
oneOf.x-text: A store file is at another schema version than the reader's.

oneOf.title: domainTooOld
oneOf.description: an installed domain is older than the version a store was checked against
oneOf.x-text: An installed domain is older than the one the store was checked against.

oneOf.title: wordUnknown
oneOf.description: a stored word is in none of the items its column is checked against
oneOf.x-text: A stored word is in none of the items its column is checked against.

oneOf.title: hotJournal
oneOf.description: a layer has a hot journal: its writer stopped inside a transaction
oneOf.x-text: A layer has a hot journal: its writer stopped inside a transaction.

oneOf.title: busy
oneOf.description: a layer stayed locked past the busy timeout
oneOf.x-text: A layer stayed locked past the timeout.

oneOf.title: entryInvalid
oneOf.description: a put whose JSON is not an entry of the description schema, or whose words are not in their items
oneOf.x-text: The entry is not an entry of the description schema, or holds a word its item lacks.

PANEL_DESCRIBE_CODES.description: The refusals describe states for a plugin (omx-panel tools/describe.mjs DESCRIBE_CODES): a stored entry with no description names the one that refused it.

oneOf.title: familyNotBacked

oneOf.x-text: The family has no panel the layout backs.

oneOf.title: layoutInvalid

oneOf.x-text: The layout the plugin states is invalid.

oneOf.title: overrideUnavailable

oneOf.x-text: An override layer was given and nothing can apply it.

oneOf.x-text: An override layer was refused.

oneOf.title: meterRefused

oneOf.x-text: A meter was refused.

oneOf.title: paramUnserved

oneOf.description: the plugin is left exactly as it is
oneOf.x-text: The plugin is left as it is.

oneOf.title: grouped
oneOf.description: every control was placed in a group
oneOf.x-text: Every control was placed in a group.

PANEL_GROUP_REASONS.description: Why the port-group inference left a plugin as it is (omx-panel docs/group-inference.md).

oneOf.title: noControls

oneOf.x-text: The plugin has no controls to place.

oneOf.title: ownGroupsComplete

oneOf.x-text: The plugin's own groups already place every control.

oneOf.x-text: A control was placed by no rule.

oneOf.title: tooManyGroups

oneOf.x-text: The rules made too many groups.

oneOf.title: mostlyByIndex

oneOf.x-text: Most controls were placed only by a run of port indexes.
